name: AppwinCore
summary: Appwin Core SDK - configuration, user identity, events, consent and push routing.
description:
Core module of the Appwin SDK, required by every product (Support,
Community, Notifications, Analytics, Attribution). Holds the configuration
(AppwinCore.configure), the user identity (identify, updateUser, logout),
your own events (AppwinCore.track), consent (AppwinCore.setConsent), push
routing (AppwinPush), product availability, and the shared plumbing:
device id, session, networking, realtime, storage and uploads.
